summary: Tested Course Launch Coupons (admin CRUD, validation, student coupon check, order endpoints) and the Shareable Course Certificate (LinkedIn share/add-to-profile, PDF/PNG, copy link, public verify page). Backend: 19 passed and 1 skipped (wrong-course test: there is only one paid course). Frontend: every requested flow works end to end. One environment note: the seeded student already has a coupon_redemptions row for LAUNCH30 ({code: LAUNCH30, user_id: b9cafa42b8ca}, no payment_id; it looks like it was inserted by hand). Because of this, LAUNCH30 correctly returns 'You've already used this coupon' for the student instead of showing ₹700. I checked the 30%→₹700 flow with my own TEST_ 30% coupon instead.

minor.issue: clean() returns 422 'Course not found' when the coupon's course_id points to a deleted course. The admin then cannot toggle that coupon's active state, and the UI shows a 'Deleted course' row whose switch fails.

One use per student is only recorded at activate() after payment. A student can open orders for course A and course B with the same all-courses coupon before paying either one, then pay both and get the discount twice.
PIL rendering plus the QR code run synchronously inside an async handler, which blocks the event loop. Wrap them in run_in_threadpool.
Returns 200 {ok:true} even if the code does not exist (no 404).

issues: The 'Buy course with Razorpay' button is disabled when Razorpay is not configured, but the glow-btn has no disabled style (no reduced opacity or not-allowed cursor), so it looks clickable.

action_items: Optional: let PUT /admin/coupons toggle active when the linked course was deleted (skip the course check when only active changes, or check only on create)
Optional: block a second pending discounted order with the same coupon (check payments with status created/paid + coupon + user_id)
Optional: add a disabled style to glow-btn
Optional: move cert_png to a threadpool
critical_code_review_comments: routes_coupons.apply_coupon: the coupon is validated before prepare(). That is fine, but plan_key validation happens after item_for, so pro_monthly with a coupon gives 400 'Coupons only work on courses' (verified).
AdminCoupons toggle sends the whole row (uses, created_at). Pydantic ignores the extras, so this works.
Verified: the frontend passes the coupon in the razorpay/cashfree order body through lib/pay.js (code review only, because the buy buttons are disabled in preview).
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_* coupons were created through the API and the UI (TEST_UI30, TEST_UIFLAT, plus random TEST_xxxxxx ones) and all were deleted, along with their test redemption rows. The final DB holds only LAUNCH30, OLD10 and FLAT200 (all pre-existing). The pre-existing LAUNCH30 redemption for the student was not touched.
